name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for OpsPilot
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: ["enhancement", "proposal"]

### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g., "I'm always frustrated when...")

### Describe the Solution You'd Like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

### Architectural Impact
- Which modules will this touch? (`apps/api`, `apps/workers`, `packages/deployment-providers`, etc.)
- Does this require changes to the database schema (`DATABASE_DESIGN.md`)?
- Does this impact tenant isolation or security boundaries?

### Describe Alternatives You've Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or diagrams about the feature request here.
